aiVerification.summary: The draft has citeable yield rows but no citeable changed-condition comparison, so it is not valid final ReviewCase evidence.
issues: No explicit baseline or test condition is evidenced.
Dates, rounds, and totals are misclassified as changed factors.
Detail rows and total rows are mixed as comparable conditions.
Outcome metric is too broad; actual metrics are NG counts/rates and defect categories.
Rows 13-19 are cited but not shown in supplied context.
correctionPlan: Do not approve this draft for Ask AI as a comparative ReviewCase.
Exclude unless source context identifies a real process/material/equipment change.
If retained descriptively, recast as a line result/yield log, not a changed-factor case.
Separate date/round detail rows from total summary rows.
Define outcomes as Input, Total NG, NG rate, and defect counts by head.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations support observed results only, not a changed-condition comparison.
